info.name: Rillet Accounting API Key Contract Items API
Lists all contract item usage records

params.name: contract_item_id
params.description: UUID of the contract line item whose usage rows are being listed.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return in the page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor to navigate through the full response.

items.docs:
Returns historical usage quantities for a contract item, newest first, with optional pagination cursors.
Use before upsert-a-usage-record or delete-a-usage-record to understand existing coverage for each date.

params.name: contract_item_id
params.description: UUID of the contract line item that carries the usage-priced product.

items.docs: Creates usage records on dates where previously no usage was recorded. Overwrites usage records on dates where usage was previously recorded already.

params.name: contract_item_id
params.description: UUID of the contract line item whose usage row should be removed.

params.name: date
params.description: Calendar date of the usage row to delete (ISO-8601 format).

items.docs:
Removes the usage entry for a single contract item on a specific calendar date.
This is narrower than upsert-a-usage-record and is ideal when you need to wipe a mistaken day without resending the entire usage payload.
